newsitem.title: USA: Cytel to restructure,spin off vaccine opns.
newsitem.headline: Cytel to restructure,spin off vaccine opns.

text.p: Cytel Corp said Wednesday it plans to restructure its operations and spin off its vaccine program.
The new vaccine company would focus on novel vaccines for treatment and prevention of cancer and infectious diseases, Cytel said.
The remaining entity would develop Cytel's therapeutic products targeting acute and chronic inflammation, and expand its carbohydrate manufacturing business.
The restructuring has been approved by the board and will occur as soon as practicable, Cytel said.

"We firmly believe that the establishment of separately managed and financed companies is the best formula for building long-term shareholder value from Cytel's current product and technology portfolio," said Virgil Thompson, Cytel president and chief executive.
He said the two entities develop products based on distinctively different technologies, have different product portfolios, and pursue different business strategies.
Cytel said it has not settled on specific financing plans or structures.
The company said its goal is to be recognized as a leader in the manufacture of bioactive carbohydrates.
